basic_details.offering_entity: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC) & London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (LSHTM)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (Keppel Street Campus, Bloomsbury, London)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Public Health, Epidemiology, Tropical Medicine & International Health, Infectious Diseases, Immunology of Infectious Diseases, Medical Microbiology, Nutrition for Global Health, and Health Policy, Planning & Financing.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~10 to 14 fully funded Commonwealth Shared Scholarships awarded across eligible LSHTM master's programmes
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Country allocation for Pakistan (~3 to 5 scholars selected per annual cohort)

nationality_requirements: Citizens and permanent residents of Commonwealth developing countries including Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Preference given to early to mid-career practitioners under 40 years of age.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized undergraduate degree (MBBS / BDS / PharmD / 16-year BS in Biomedical Sciences, Public Health, Nursing, or Microbiology) from an HEC/PMDC-recognized university with high upper second-class or first-class honors (minimum CGPA 3.30 / 4.00 or 75%+).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.30 / 4.00; competitive medical/public health candidates typically hold CGPA >= 3.60 / 4.00 with verified clinical or epidemiological experience.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Professional qualification or undergraduate degree in medicine, public health, biological sciences, or related health discipline with unconditional or conditional admission offer from LSHTM.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated and unable to afford to study in the UK without this scholarship.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: No restriction on year of graduation.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Clinical medical practice, public health NGO work, epidemiological fieldwork, or disease surveillance experience in Pakistan strongly required.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in all sub-components or TOEFL iBT minimum 100 (min 24 in writing). MOI certificates are strictly not accepted under UK VI and CSC rules.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must sign a declaration confirming they could not otherwise afford to study in the UK.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Candidates who have previously studied for one academic year or more in a high-income country are ineligible.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full international tuition fees covered jointly by the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission and LSHTM (worth up to GBP 29,800).
tuition_fee.amount: 100% Full UK Tuition Fees Covered (up to GBP 29,800 value)

admission_application_fee.details: LSHTM MSc application fee of GBP 50 payable during online course application submission.

accommodation.details: Covered from the monthly London maintenance stipend; University of London housing services assist with Bloomsbury student residences.

monthly_stipend.details: GBP 1,652 / month London living allowance (~PKR 615,000 / month | GBP 19,824 total over 12 months) paid monthly.

airfare.details: Approved return economy international flights between Pakistan and London Heathrow booked directly by CSC.

visa_fee.details: UK Student Visa application fee and full Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) covered directly by the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission.
visa_fee.amount: 100% UK Visa & Immigration Health Surcharge Covered

health_insurance.details: Full access to the UK National Health Service (NHS) for the duration of the scholarship.

food_allowance.details: Covered via monthly GBP 1,652 living stipend plus access to subsidized University of London student dining facilities.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Study travel grant provided towards the cost of study-related travel within the UK or overseas dissertation fieldwork.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Dissertation grant contribution towards field research expenses and access to world-leading tropical health labs.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Initial arrival allowance of GBP 575 to assist with warm clothing, transit, and initial establishment in London.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine - LSHTM, London, UK).
participating_institutions: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (LSHTM)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: World #1 or #2 institution for public health and infectious disease research (US News / Shanghai Rankings).
available_majors: MSc in Public Health (General, Health Economics, Health Promotion, Environment)
MSc in Tropical Medicine & International Health
MSc in Immunology of Infectious Diseases
MSc in Nutrition for Global Health
MSc in Health Policy, Planning & Financing
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 1 year (12 months full-time intensive master's degree)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor/MBBS degree (CGPA >= 3.30/4.00), official IELTS 7.0+ (min 6.5 each) or TOEFL 100+, at least 1 year relevant public health experience, admission offer from LSHTM, and CSC online application.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Must apply to both LSHTM for an MSc admission offer AND to the CSC Electronic Application System (EAS) before the mid-December deadline.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus scholarship development impact statement on Pakistan's pressing health burdens (hepatitis eradication, maternal child nutrition, polio eradication, infectious outbreak response).

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission Electronic Application System (CSC EAS) & LSHTM Admissions Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Apply for an eligible MSc programme at LSHTM via lshtm.ac.uk by late November. Step 2: Register on the CSC Electronic Application System (EAS) and submit the Commonwealth Shared Scholarship application before December 15, 16:00 GMT.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Review eligible LSHTM master's programmes on the CSC Commonwealth Shared Scholarships portal.
Step 2: Submit an application for admission to an eligible MSc course at LSHTM before December 1.
Step 3: Register on the CSC Electronic Application System (EAS).
Step 4: Complete the detailed CSC application form, including the 4-part Development Impact statement.
Step 5: Upload degree transcripts, certificates, passport, and details of two academic/professional referees before December 15.
Step 6: LSHTM shortlists eligible candidates and submits nominations to the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in March.
Step 7: CSC Selection Committee reviews nominations and confirms final awards in May.
Step 8: Final award letters issued in June; CSC arranges visa, flights, and pre-departure briefings.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Dual Application System: Candidates must submit an application to LSHTM for university admission AND a separate application to the CSC EAS for scholarship funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by two referees directly to the CSC Electronic Application System before the referee deadline.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Four-part Development Impact statement: (1) How your study relates to global development issues, (2) How you plan to apply your new skills upon return, (3) Expected national impact in Pakistan, (4) Measurable indicators of success.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Brief outline of desired MSc dissertation research topic in public health or epidemiology.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed professional CV highlighting clinical practice, epidemiological research, community health campaigns, and publications.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews; selection is based entirely on the written application materials, academic record, and development impact essays.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 7.0+ (min 6.5 each) or TOEFL iBT 100+ (min 24 writing).
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: GBP 50 (LSHTM course application fee; CSC scholarship application is free)
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC and PMDC/PNC degree attestations from Pakistan.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official English translation for all academic records.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via CSC Electronic Application System (EAS) and LSHTM portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: HEC/PMDC-attested medical or health degree with high academic standing.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC and PMDC/PNC Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts of medical or undergraduate studies showing marks and grading scales.
Proof of application or admission offer to an eligible LSHTM master's programme.
Comprehensive essays explaining the development impact of the proposed studies on Pakistan's health systems.
Professional CV detailing clinical roles, public health fieldwork, and publications.
Confidential referee appraisals submitted directly to the CSC EAS system.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: One academic and one professional supervisor.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS (min 7.0) or TOEFL iBT (min 100) scorecard.
Clear scan of passport identification page confirming Pakistani nationality.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: CSC EAS application strictly closes mid-December (16:00 GMT); university application must be submitted prior.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Academic merit of the candidate and clinical/undergraduate transcript excellence)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 15% (Public health advocacy, leadership in medical campaigns, community health initiatives)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (Clinical research, epidemiological surveys, and relevant publications)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 15% (Quality and depth of professional public health/clinical work experience)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 20% (Quality and feasibility of the 4-part Development Impact statement for Pakistan)
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: 0% (Qualifying prerequisite: candidate must state financial need)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: LSHTM Academic Review Panels and Commonwealth Scholarship Commission Selection Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-tier review: university scoring and nomination followed by central CSC selection committee ratification.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~800 to 1,200 medical and health practitioners applying for LSHTM Commonwealth awards
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.70 / 4.00 with demonstrated frontline clinical or epidemiological work
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Physicians (MBBS), epidemiologists, or public health researchers with clear commitment to strengthening Pakistan's health sector.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from King Edward Medical University, Aga Khan University, Dow University of Health Sciences, and Army Medical College.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Nigeria, Kenya, Uganda, Bangladesh, Ghana, India.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official CSC portal https://cscuk.fcdo.gov.uk/ and lshtm.ac.uk.
Neither the CSC nor LSHTM ever charges any fee for scholarship application or processing.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: CSC application is completely free; only LSHTM charges standard GBP 50 course application fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Commercial agencies are strictly disqualified; essays must be the applicant's original work.
hidden_costs_breakdown: HEC and PMDC document attestation fees: ~PKR 15,000 - 25,000.
All flights, visas, and health surcharges are 100% COVERED by CSC upon selection.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships are open to candidates living abroad. Reality: Candidates must be permanently resident in an eligible Commonwealth developing country at application.
Myth: You can remain in the UK indefinitely after studies. Reality: Scholars sign an explicit undertaking to return to their home country upon completing the scholarship.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sources claim HEC HAT test is mandatory for Shared Scholarships; while HEC nominates for standard Commonwealth General, Shared Scholarships are applied for DIRECTLY with the university and CSC.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance and complete all module assessments.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory full-time attendance on campus at LSHTM in London; active participation in CSC regional events.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Termly progress reports submitted by LSHTM tutors to the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may not engage in paid employment without prior written permission from the CSC.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Mandatory return to Pakistan upon completion of the scholarship to contribute to national health development.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Obligation to return to Pakistan and work in the health sector.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Recovery of fellowship funds in case of breach of the undertaking to return or premature withdrawal.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing course is not permitted under the Commonwealth Shared Scholarship agreement.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is strictly limited to 12 months; no extensions permitted.
